# WHO HAS SIGNED THE CLA — one GitHub login a line, lowercase.
#
# THIS FILE IS THE RECORD, and the only one. `CLA.md` §7 says the signature is
# recorded against a GitHub account and covers every later contribution, so a
# name here is what "signed" means; the comment on a pull request is how
# somebody ASKS to be added, not the record itself.
#
# ADDING A NAME IS A DELIBERATE ACT. `cla.yml` refuses a pull request from
# anybody not listed, and a name added without the signature comment on the
# pull request is a contribution nobody agreed to license — which is exactly
# the thing that cannot be repaired later.
